description: This PHP class 'GeneratorHelper' provides static utility methods for recursive directory removal and copying files/directories. It includes methods rmdir() to delete directories and their contents, and copyRecursive() to copy files and directories recursively.

classes.name: GeneratorHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for recursive directory removal and copying.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory and its contents recursively.

methods.name: copyRecursive
methods.description: Copies files and directories from source to destination recursively.
